turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's zero. Who decided it, and did anyone speak to him first?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
Does he. What does he say?
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
He is. That's not why I'm here, Hale. What do you have?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
No. You've just said he cheated, and you haven't shown me a single thing. My son doesn't lie. Is that what you're telling me, Hale?
